neighbours.label: the word 'related' / 'relation' (being connected to something), as against phrasings that state the same link without it
fire: The clinic sees many injuries related to winter sports.
Officials released new data on crimes related to drug trafficking.
Two men were arrested in relation to the warehouse fire.
Further reading: related articles on soil health and crop rotation
The committee studies questions related to water rights in the valley.
Most complaints were related to late deliveries over the holidays.
He was fined in relation to unpaid taxes from 2019.
Several deaths in the region were related to the heat wave.
quiet: The clinic sees many injuries during winter sports.
Officials released new data on crimes in the border towns.
Two men were arrested after the warehouse fire.
Further reading: short articles on soil health and crop rotation
The committee studies questions about water rights in the valley.
Most complaints came from customers over the holidays.
He was fined for unpaid taxes from 2019.
Several deaths in the region happened during the heat wave.
